checks.finding: All six source files and two license files independently fetched at the declared immutable commit equal retained bytes, size and SHA-256; URLs contain the same commit and upstream path.

Independent signature-to-unindented-close extraction confirms the two quantizers, approximate acos, encoder and decoder are byte-identical occurrences and match all declared function hashes; implementation extractor was not used.
is_zero_v3, compare_ff, compare_v3v3, mul_v3_v3fl and madd_v3_v3fl bodies are byte-identical to their pinned definitions.

dot starts a[0]*b[0], then accumulates indices1 and2 in order. Independently fetched vector unroll macros establish elementwise +, scalar multiply and scalar division; wrapper uses the same operations without reciprocal substitution.

Pinned normalize calls normalize_and_get_length: squared dot; threshold1e-35f; float sqrt; per-component divide; otherwise zero. Wrapper output matches this route; omitted local out_length reset is unobservable to its caller. Separate C reciprocal/multiply helper is not substituted.

Pinned pi definition rounds to the same double/f32 constants used by the scalar adapter. Encoder retains 1.0f-1e-4f and floorf(val*float(SHRT_MAX)+0.5f), not symmetric rounding. IEEE binary32/16-bit short static assertions and contraction/fast-math exclusions are explicit.

Final source verifies fesetround/fegetround and separately reports subnormal parsing and volatile arithmetic observations; actual FLT_EVAL_METHOD and compiler/libc identity remain observed evidence rather than a cross-platform guarantee.

Required operation inputs are explicit; decode shorts require exact non-boolean JSON integers in[-32768,32767]. Explicit codec frames must be finite and satisfy declared unit/orthogonal/right-handed/range checks after f32 conversion. These are experiment preconditions, not native-frame reachability proof.

strict normalizes and refuses collapse; unit bypasses setter normalization; zero-sentinel permits only zero; invalid-range-fallback is decode-only with an otherwise admissible frame and zero alpha/beta. Encoder division on invalid frames is excluded. Raw decoder fallback is retained exactly.

Component/angle/drift formulas are consistent with the reported f32 encoder input. Strict-mode normalization is a separate conditioning stage: metrics do not compare nonunit raw vector magnitude to decoded output. atan2 cross/dot angle uses normalized double vectors; zero-sentinel has no meaningful angle.

Final runner removes kernelExecuted; it distinguishes probeProcessExecuted, codecEncoderExecuted, codecDecoderExecuted, inputNormalizationExecuted and standaloneHelperExecuted. Wrapper refusals set codec fields false; a strict normalization-collapse refusal records prior normalization.

Implementation text and source bindings disclaim native replay, fan/topology/averaging reconstruction, binary attestation, universal error bounds and replacement tolerance. No Blender launch/import path occurs in the harness. Original 2e-6 failed receiving requirement remains unchanged.

Original SPDX notices are retained, derived C++/include carry GPL-2.0-or-later notices, and pinned COPYING/GPL text hashes match primary source. This records supplied attribution evidence, not a general legal conclusion.

limits: Primary-source characterization is not proof of the retained C211 executable source lineage or bitwise behavior
Supplied frames are admissible experiment inputs; no native frame/short pair is fabricated
Finite observations cannot establish a universal bound or replace the strict receiving tolerance
Roundtrip metrics are against actual conditioned f32 encoder inputs, with original inputs recorded separately
Initial and corrected implementation smoke records remain historical; final observations must bind the final executable inputs
